Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final engineConfig = await createCrawlConfigFromJson(json: r'{"max_depth":1,"respect_robots_txt":false}');

    final url = 'https://example.com';
    final result = await CrawlbergBridge.crawl(engine, url);
